name: Method-author epoch ceilings with common DSPT data/selection/FP32 conditions
training_windows: all cycles, left zero padding of short prefixes
selection: mean per-engine validation RMSE; replay min_delta state machine
test_rule: both conditions fully trained/frozen before TEST; shared selected state+forward contract reuses one TEST prediction file, no repeated forward
optimizer_lr_batch: retained per original method; not equal gradient steps/compute

two_phase_pretraining.paired: FD001+FD003 / FD002+FD004; both validation engine sets excluded
two_phase_pretraining.resource_condition: additional paired-subset data and pretraining; reported separately
two_phase_pretraining.seed_policy: retain frozen prior whole-pipeline FT-before-PRE seed policy; no phase reseeding

failure_branch: retain failure; at most two cause-specific repairs/new attempts; no source substitution or test-tuned search
registration_basis: protocol amendment based only on training/validation before any new TEST; original40 condition retained
extension_eligibility: old epochs_run==40 AND 40-best_epoch<12 AND author ceiling>40
reuse_rule: references remain40; other early-patience cases reused only where all training operations/schedulers are independent of max epochs; preserve originalconfig/hash, never claim rerun
extension_rule: fresh full same-seed training incl paired pretrain; no model-only continuation
primary_comparison: author_epoch_limit condition; fixed40 is separate budget sensitivity
